highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 Preview 1 introduces Skia m156 with native GTK4 GPU rendering and Linux font discovery fixes.
highlights_body: It also aligns .NET 11 and WASM native assets, adds Tizen 10 native builds, and updates platform build support.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m156 and incorporates the current main-line engine cleanup.

bullets.lead: GTK4 gains native GPU rendering and pixel scaling
bullets.detail: Adds native GPU rendering and pixel-scaling support for GTK4 applications.
Restores system-font discovery for Linux applications using the NoDependencies package variant.
Adds GCC 14.2 native build and packaging support for Tizen 10.

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 opens the 4.156 line with Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering, Linux font discovery restoration, and platform build updates.

harfbuzz_summary: Aligns HarfBuzzSharp native assets with the .NET 11, Windows, and Tizen platform build updates.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 Preview 1 introduces Skia m156 with native GTK4 GPU rendering.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: It restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery and adds Tizen 10 native build support.
